title: Egyptian authorities board up the paw and drill misleading holes
summary: Matt LaCroix tells of Egyptian authorities board up the paw and drill misleading holes, about 1990s at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: down there and the Egyptian authorities came through and they boarded up the front of the Paw with boards literal boards and blocked it off

plain: A researcher named Matt LaCroix, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that in the 1990s, after people had been digging around beneath the Sphinx in Giza, Egypt, Egyptian authorities came and boarded up the front of one of its paws with literal wooden boards, blocking it off. The story as told also says misleading holes were drilled there. If true, it would suggest the authorities were hiding something under the Sphinx.
